pinyin: huò bǐ sān jiā bù chī kuī
literal: goods · compare · three · shops · not · suffer loss
natural: compare three shops and you won't lose out

meaning.en: Compare goods at several shops before buying and you won't be cheated.
meaning.zh: 买东西多比较几家，就不会吃亏。

examples.zh: 货比三家不吃亏，先看看别的店再买。
examples.en: Compare three shops and you won't lose out; look at other stores first.

examples.zh: 买房子要货比三家不吃亏，别急着签约。
examples.en: Shop around when buying a home; don't rush to sign.

usage.en: Everyday shopping advice.
usage.zh: 日常购物建议。

pinyin: jiǔ xiāng bù pà xiàng zi shēn
literal: wine · fragrant · not · fear · alley · deep
natural: good wine needs no signboard even deep in an alley

meaning.en: Quality speaks for itself, even without advertising.
meaning.zh: 东西好，即使地方偏僻也会有人来买。

examples.zh: 酒香不怕巷子深，这家小店天天排长队。
examples.en: Good wine fears no deep alley; this little shop has a queue every day.

examples.zh: 人家说酒香不怕巷子深，可好产品也要做宣传。
examples.en: They say good wine needs no advertising, but good products must still be promoted.

usage.en: Often challenged in marketing talk with 酒香也怕巷子深.
usage.zh: 营销中常有人反说“酒香也怕巷子深”。

pinyin: shì jīn zi zǒng huì fā guāng de
literal: be · gold · always · will · shine · (particle)
natural: gold will always shine

meaning.en: Real talent will eventually be recognised.
meaning.zh: 有真才实学的人，总有一天会被发现。

examples.zh: 别灰心，是金子总会发光的。
examples.en: Don't lose heart; gold will always shine.

examples.zh: 他默默努力多年，终于证明了是金子总会发光的。
examples.en: After years of quiet effort he proved that gold will always shine.

usage.en: Encouragement to the overlooked.
usage.zh: 用来鼓励怀才不遇的人。

pinyin: cái bù wài lù
literal: wealth · not · outward · show
natural: don't show your wealth

meaning.en: Do not flaunt your wealth, lest you attract thieves.
meaning.zh: 不要把钱财炫耀给别人看，以免招来祸患。

examples.zh: 出门旅游要记得财不外露。
examples.en: Remember not to show your wealth when travelling.

examples.zh: 财不外露，别在陌生人面前数钱。
examples.en: Don't flaunt it; don't count money in front of strangers.

usage.en: Advice on prudence and safety.
usage.zh: 谨慎防范的忠告。

pinyin: lǐ duō rén bù guài
literal: courtesy · much · people · not · blame
natural: no one blames you for too much courtesy

meaning.en: You will never offend people by being excessively polite.
meaning.zh: 客气周到一点，别人不会责怪。

examples.zh: 礼多人不怪，拜访长辈带点水果吧。
examples.en: Too much courtesy offends no one; take some fruit when you visit elders.

examples.zh: 礼多人不怪，邮件里多说几句谢谢。
examples.en: Nobody minds good manners; say thanks a few more times in your email.

usage.en: Sometimes used jokingly to excuse flattery or gifts.
usage.zh: 有时也半开玩笑地用于送礼奉承。

pinyin: yǐ yá huán yá, yǐ yǎn huán yǎn
literal: with · tooth · repay · tooth, with · eye · repay · eye
natural: a tooth for a tooth, an eye for an eye

meaning.en: To retaliate in kind for the harm done to you.
meaning.zh: 对方怎样伤害自己，就怎样回击对方。

examples.zh: 以牙还牙，以眼还眼只会让冲突升级。
examples.en: An eye for an eye only escalates the conflict.

examples.zh: 他认定以牙还牙，以眼还眼，非要报复不可。
examples.en: He was determined to give as good as he got and take revenge.

usage.en: Neutral to negative; often shortened to 以牙还牙. Linked to the ancient Near-Eastern law of retaliation.
usage.zh: 可贬可中，常简说“以牙还牙”。

text: 各人自扫门前雪，莫管他人瓦上霜
pinyin: gè rén zì sǎo mén qián xuě, mò guǎn tā rén wǎ shàng shuāng
variants: 各人自扫门前雪，莫管他家瓦上霜
literal: each · person · himself · sweep · door · front · snow, don't · mind · others · tile · on · frost
natural: sweep your own doorstep, ignore frost on others' roofs

meaning.en: Mind your own business and ignore other people's troubles.
meaning.zh: 只管自己的事，不管别人的事。

examples.zh: 他信奉各人自扫门前雪，莫管他人瓦上霜，邻里有事从不过问。
examples.en: He lives by 'sweep your own snow, leave others' frost'; he never asks about neighbours' affairs.

examples.zh: 各人自扫门前雪，莫管他人瓦上霜，这种态度社区没法建好。
examples.en: 'Sweep your own doorstep' is not an attitude to build a community on.

usage.en: Often criticism of indifference; sometimes a plain call to stay out of things.
usage.zh: 多批评冷漠，有时也只是劝人少管闲事。

pinyin: shuō cáo cāo, cáo cāo dào
literal: speak · Cao Cao, Cao Cao · arrives
natural: speak of Cao Cao and Cao Cao appears

meaning.en: Said when the person you were just talking about turns up.
meaning.zh: 刚说到某人，某人就出现了。

examples.zh: 说曹操，曹操到，我们正聊你呢。
examples.en: Speak of the devil; we were just talking about you.

examples.zh: 说曹操，曹操到，老板刚好走进办公室。
examples.en: Talk of the devil: the boss walked into the office just then.

usage.en: Light-hearted, casual; the 就 form 说曹操曹操就到 is also very common.
usage.zh: 语气轻松，口语，“说曹操曹操就到”也很常见。

pinyin: guāng shuō bù liàn jiǎ bǎ shì
literal: only · talk · not · practise · fake · skill
natural: all talk and no practice is a sham

meaning.en: Someone who only talks and never practises is a fake.
meaning.zh: 只会说、不去实践，就是空架子。

examples.zh: 光说不练假把式，来真格的试试。
examples.en: All talk and no practice is a sham; let's see you do it for real.

examples.zh: 光说不练假把式，他嘴上说健身，却没去过健身房。
examples.en: Talk without practice is fake; he says he's fit but never goes to the gym.

usage.en: Challenges someone to prove it; often follows 练的是真把式.
usage.zh: 用来让人拿出真本事，常与“光练不说傻把式”相对。

pinyin: ěr tīng wéi xū, yǎn jiàn wéi shí
literal: ear · hear · is · false, eye · see · is · real
natural: hearing is false, seeing is real

meaning.en: What you hear may be false, but what you see yourself is reliable.
meaning.zh: 听到的不一定可靠，亲眼看到的才可信。

examples.zh: 耳听为虚，眼见为实，你自己去看看吧。
examples.en: Hearsay may be false; go and see for yourself.

examples.zh: 耳听为虚，眼见为实，别轻信传言。
examples.en: Seeing is believing; don't trust rumours.

usage.en: Advice to verify; the saying has a hint that even sight can deceive.
usage.zh: 劝人亲自核实。

pinyin: hǎo le shāng bā wàng le téng
literal: healed · scar · forget · pain
natural: once the wound heals, you forget the pain

meaning.en: To forget a painful lesson as soon as the trouble is over.
meaning.zh: 伤口好了就忘了疼痛，比喻事情过去后就忘了教训。

equivalents: once the danger is past, God is forgotten

examples.zh: 上次被罚还不够？好了伤疤忘了疼！
examples.en: Weren't you punished last time? You forget the pain once it heals!

examples.zh: 他戒赌没几天又去了，真是好了伤疤忘了疼。
examples.en: He went back to gambling after a few days; he forgets the lesson once the pain goes.

usage.en: Reproving; casual.
usage.zh: 带责备，口语。

antonyms: 一朝被蛇咬，十年怕井绳

pinyin: yī jiā rén bù shuō liǎng jiā huà
literal: one · family · not · speak · two · families' · words
natural: one family doesn't speak two families' words

meaning.en: Family or close friends should speak frankly and not stand on ceremony.
meaning.zh: 自家人之间不必说客气话、见外话。

equivalents: we're family, no need to be polite

examples.zh: 一家人不说两家话，你有困难就开口。
examples.en: We're family, no need to stand on ceremony; tell me if you're in trouble.

examples.zh: 一家人不说两家话，谢什么谢。
examples.en: Family doesn't talk like strangers; no need to thank me.

usage.en: Warm; used to wave away thanks or politeness.
usage.zh: 亲切，用来免去客套。

pinyin: yī shǒu jiāo qián, yī shǒu jiāo huò
literal: one · hand · hand over · money, one · hand · hand over · goods
natural: money with one hand, goods with the other

meaning.en: Payment and delivery happen at the same moment, with no credit.
meaning.zh: 钱和货当场两清，不赊账。

examples.zh: 规矩是一手交钱，一手交货，没钱别拿货。
examples.en: The rule is cash on delivery; no money, no goods.

examples.zh: 一手交钱，一手交货，咱们谁也不吃亏。
examples.en: Pay with one hand, hand over goods with the other; nobody loses out.

usage.en: A direct bargaining phrase; sometimes used in crime dramas.
usage.zh: 直接的交易用语，影视中常出现。

text: 一瓶子不响，半瓶子晃荡
pinyin: yī píng zi bù xiǎng, bàn píng zi huàng dàng
literal: one · bottle · not · sound, half · bottle · slosh
natural: a full bottle is silent, a half-full one sloshes

meaning.en: People who know a lot are modest; those with a little knowledge show off.
meaning.zh: 满瓶子不出声，半瓶子乱响；比喻学问深的人谦虚，略知皮毛的人爱炫耀。

equivalents: empty vessels make the most noise

examples.zh: 他刚学了点皮毛就到处说教，一瓶子不响，半瓶子晃荡。
examples.en: He picked up a smattering and lectures everyone: a full bottle is silent, a half one sloshes.

examples.zh: 真正的专家很低调，一瓶子不响，半瓶子晃荡。
examples.en: Real experts are modest; the half-full bottle is the noisy one.

usage.en: Mocks show-offs; casual, sometimes sarcastic.
usage.zh: 嘲讽爱卖弄的人，口语，略带讽刺。

pinyin: sān tiān bù dǎ, shàng fáng jiē wǎ
literal: three · days · not · hit, climb · roof · lift · tiles
natural: three days without a beating and he's up on the roof pulling off tiles

meaning.en: A naughty child (or person) gets out of hand without discipline.
meaning.zh: 孩子或人若不管教，几天就调皮得无法无天。

equivalents: spare the rod and spoil the child
give them an inch and they take a mile

examples.zh: 这孩子三天不打，上房揭瓦，得管管了。
examples.en: Three days without a smack and he's on the roof; he needs discipline.

examples.zh: 别太纵容猫，三天不打，上房揭瓦。
examples.en: Don't indulge the cat; without discipline it runs wild.

usage.en: Often half-joking, said with exasperated affection about naughty kids or pets.
usage.zh: 常半开玩笑，带着无奈的亲昵。

pinyin: shàng yī cì dàng, xué yī cì guāi
literal: fall for · one · time · trick, learn · one · time · wisdom
natural: each time you are fooled, you grow a little wiser

meaning.en: Every time you are tricked, you learn something.
meaning.zh: 每被骗一次，就多一分经验。

examples.zh: 上一次当，学一次乖，下回不会再信了。
examples.en: Fooled once, wiser once; I won't trust it again.

examples.zh: 买了假货才懂，上一次当，学一次乖。
examples.en: I learned only after buying fakes: every trick teaches a lesson.

usage.en: Mild self-consolation after being cheated.
usage.zh: 被骗后的自我宽慰。

pinyin: shàng yǒu zhèng cè, xià yǒu duì cè
literal: above · have · policy, below · have · countermeasure
natural: the top has policies, the bottom has countermeasures

meaning.en: However the authorities tighten rules, people find ways round them.
meaning.zh: 上面有规定，下面就有对付的办法。

equivalents: where there's a rule, there's a loophole

examples.zh: 上有政策，下有对策，禁令总有人钻空子。
examples.en: Policies from above, workarounds from below; someone always finds a loophole.

examples.zh: 上有政策，下有对策，政府要堵住漏洞。
examples.en: With rules above and tricks below, the government must close the loopholes.

usage.en: A wry comment on evasion of regulations.
usage.zh: 对规避管理的无奈评论。

text: 不怕不识货，只怕货比货
pinyin: bù pà bù shí huò, zhǐ pà huò bǐ huò
variants: 不怕不识货，就怕货比货
literal: not · fear · not · know · goods, only · fear · goods · compare · goods
natural: not afraid you can't judge goods, only of comparison

meaning.en: A comparison quickly reveals which goods are better.
meaning.zh: 不怕不懂行，就怕东西放在一起比较，好坏一目了然。

examples.zh: 不怕不识货，只怕货比货，一对比就知道差距。
examples.en: Even a novice can see the gap once you compare.

examples.zh: 不怕不识货，只怕货比货，两款手机一比，高下立判。
examples.en: Put the two phones together and the better one is obvious.

usage.en: Used when a comparison exposes weak quality.
usage.zh: 当比较暴露差距时使用。

text: 不是一家人不进一家门
pinyin: bù shì yī jiā rén bù jìn yī jiā mén
literal: not · be · one · family · not · enter · one · family's · door
natural: people not of one family don't enter one door

meaning.en: Couples or relatives usually share the same character.
meaning.zh: 一家人往往性格脾气相似。

equivalents: birds of a feather flock together

examples.zh: 不是一家人不进一家门，他们夫妻俩一样爱占便宜。
examples.en: Like husband like wife; both love getting a bargain.

examples.zh: 不是一家人不进一家门，兄弟俩都爱管闲事。
examples.en: Brothers of one household; both love meddling.

usage.en: Often says couples are alike, usually with a critical note.
usage.zh: 多说夫妻或亲人相似，常带批评。

text: 不听老人言，吃亏在眼前
pinyin: bù tīng lǎo rén yán, chī kuī zài yǎn qián
literal: not · listen · old · people's · words, suffer loss · at · eye · front
natural: ignore the old and you'll lose out soon

meaning.en: If you ignore the advice of the elderly, you will soon suffer.
meaning.zh: 不听长辈经验之谈，很快就会吃亏。

examples.zh: 不听老人言，吃亏在眼前，早知道听奶奶的了。
examples.en: Ignore the elderly and you'll suffer; I should have listened to Grandma.

examples.zh: 不听老人言，吃亏在眼前，他又摔了一跤。
examples.en: He ignored warnings and fell again.

usage.en: Often rueful or scolding; may be disputed by the young.
usage.zh: 多带懊悔或责备，年轻人未必认同。

pinyin: bù zhēng mán tou zhēng kǒu qì
literal: not · steam · bun · fight for · breath
natural: if not for steamed buns, then to win a breath

meaning.en: To refuse to give in, for the sake of pride, in the face of slights.
meaning.zh: 为了争一口气、不被人看不起而努力。

examples.zh: 不蒸馒头争口气，我要考上让他们看看。
examples.en: For the sake of pride I'll pass and show them.

examples.zh: 他不蒸馒头争口气，咬牙把店撑了下来。
examples.en: For pride's sake he gritted his teeth and kept the shop going.

usage.en: A pun on 蒸 (steam) and 争 (fight), both zhēng. Casual.
usage.zh: 利用“蒸”和“争”同音，口语。

pinyin: bù yào zài yī kē shù shàng diào sǐ
literal: not · should · on · one · tree · hang · die
natural: don't hang yourself on a single tree

meaning.en: Don't pin everything on one choice; look for other options.
meaning.zh: 不要死守一条路，要多找出路。

equivalents: don't put all your eggs in one basket
there are plenty more fish in the sea

examples.zh: 不要在一棵树上吊死，这家不行再试试别家。
examples.en: Don't hang yourself on one tree; if this firm won't do, try others.

examples.zh: 失恋了也不要在一棵树上吊死，还有很多好人。
examples.en: Even after a break-up, don't fixate on one; there are plenty of good people.

usage.en: Casual advice; the image is blunt, avoid in formal writing.
usage.zh: 口语劝告，用词较直，不宜用于正式场合。

pinyin: liǎng hǔ xiāng zhēng, bì yǒu yī shāng
literal: two · tigers · fight, surely · have · one · hurt
natural: when two tigers fight, one will be hurt

meaning.en: When two strong sides fight, at least one will be injured.
meaning.zh: 两个强者相斗，必定有一方受损。

equivalents: when two elephants fight, the grass suffers

examples.zh: 两虎相争，必有一伤，何必斗得两败俱伤。
examples.en: When two tigers fight, one is hurt; why fight until both lose.

examples.zh: 两虎相争，必有一伤，劝你们各退一步。
examples.en: Two tigers fighting will wound one; I urge you both to back off.

usage.en: A warning against conflict between powerful sides.
usage.zh: 告诫强者之间不要争斗。

pinyin: rén zài jiāng hú, shēn bù yóu jǐ
literal: person · in · rivers and lakes, body · not · by · self
natural: in the jianghu, you're not your own master

meaning.en: Once caught up in the world's affairs, one cannot do as one pleases.
meaning.zh: 进入社会或某个圈子后，行动受到各种牵制，不能自己做主。

examples.zh: 人在江湖，身不由己，我也不想加班。
examples.en: In the world, you're not your own master; I don't want overtime either.

examples.zh: 人在江湖，身不由己，他只得接受安排。
examples.en: Not his own master, he had to accept the arrangement.

usage.en: Quoted from martial-arts fiction; a weary sigh at work or society.
usage.zh: 武侠小说里常见，用于感叹工作或社会。

pinyin: rén shēng yī shì, cǎo mù yī chūn
literal: human · live · one · lifetime, grass · tree · one · spring
natural: a human life is one lifetime, as plants have one spring

meaning.en: Life is short, like a plant's single spring, so make the most of it.
meaning.zh: 人生短暂，如同草木只有一个春天。

examples.zh: 人生一世，草木一春，该做的事趁早做。
examples.en: Life is as brief as a plant's spring; do what you want to do soon.

examples.zh: 人生一世，草木一春，何必为小事烦恼。
examples.en: A lifetime is one spring; why worry over small things.

usage.en: Reflective, sometimes to justify enjoying life.
usage.zh: 带感慨，有时用来表示及时行乐。
